idea-plugin.name: Kotlin Auto Refactor (K2)
idea-plugin.description: Refactors Kotlin classes, functions, and variables throughout writable project sources by replacing an optional existing suffix and appending a configurable suffix. This build targets the Kotlin K2 mode and uses the Kotlin Analysis API directly (no reflection) for property/getter disambiguation and override resolution.

action.description: Refactor Kotlin classes, functions, and variables using the K2 Analysis API
